verdict.rationale: Termius advertises 'device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics' (termius-docs-14) and SSH key management with passphrase protection synced across devices (termius-docs-12), suggesting some biometric-gated access, but this is not explicitly described as hardware-backed secure enclave storage of private keys. A community commenter flags as a downside that Termius stores SSH keys on Termius's own servers rather than in local hardware enclaves, directly undercutting the 'hardware-backed secure enclave' framing (termius-comm-13). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of secure-enclave/TPM-backed key storage, independent verification of biometric-gated key unlock, and resolution of the server-storage concern.
